Hi Megan — really appreciate the clear asks. Below is our recommended operational pattern (we can adapt if needed):

- Monthly drawdown windows: We process committed spend drawdowns on the 1st and 15th of each month at 00:00 UTC. For accounts on annual prepay, the system will auto-withdraw the planned monthly tranche on whichever of those two windows falls after the billing cycle alignment date (you pick either 1st or 15th during onboarding).

- Ad-hoc top-ups: Available. You can request an on-demand top-up via the Console (Finance > Payments > Request Top-up) or by emailing billing@redwood.ai with the PO# and wire confirmation. Top-ups requested before the 11:00 UTC cutoff are processed same-day in the next window.

- Rollback / unused credit: We offer three options and will default to option A unless you elect otherwise in the MSA:
  A) Credit rollover to next contract year (no fee)
  B) Refund of remaining balance (standard 14 business day processing; wire fee of $25 retained)
  C) Convert remaining credit to pay-as-you-go tokens at the contracted committed rate for 90 days post-termination

Note: Refunds trigger a final reconciliation invoice for usage to date and require Treasury sign-off.

- Access & audit trail: Admin users you designate in Console have Drawdown, Billing, and Audit roles. Every drawdown request generates an immutable ledger entry (timestamp, requester, tranche id, and effective amount) which we can export as CSV or provide as S3 delivery for audit.

- Tax / VAT: For EU routing, we need the invoice remit entity, VAT registration number, and the EU entity's billing address. If invoices should be issued to an EU legal entity, please provide the registration docs; otherwise we will issue to Starlite US and include zero-rated export evidence if applicable.

I've attached the mutual action plan template and wire instructions for your treasury team. I'll loop Jordan in next for final MOP and HubSpot record sync.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Megan — quick operational notes from a billing perspective so your AP team can prepare: 

- Invoices & numbering: For annual prepay we issue a single invoice for the committed amount at activation, followed by monthly drawdown ledger entries. If you elect the monthly amortization model (you indicated you prefer monthly withdrawals) we'll still issue an activation invoice and then post internal tranche invoices to your ledger for visibility (these tranche records are not separate billable invoices unless you request a refund).

- PO requirements: Please provide your PO number and remit-to address. If Starlite wants invoices directed to Starlite EU GmbH (for example), include the EU VAT number and the legal entity name exactly as it appears on the VAT certificate.

- Evidence for VAT: For tax routing to EU entities we need either (a) VAT registration plus a signed statement confirming intra-EU reverse charge eligibility or (b) confirmation that Redwood should zero-rate exports to the EU entity and the supporting import/export docs. If you send VAT files we will attach them to the invoice metadata for your auditors.

- Banking: Wire_Instructions_Starlite.xlsx contains our account and intermediary details. Once we receive the activation payment, please email remit-confirm@redwood.ai with the wire trace so we can reconcile immediately and schedule the first tranche.

I'll stand by for PO and VAT docs — copying AP.

Regards,
